public final class EnumSetting<E extends Enum<E>> extends Setting<E>
A single choice from an enum, rendered as a dropdown or a cycling button.

The old client detected enum settings by ruling out every other type (isEnumSetting() returned "not a number, string, char, or boolean"). Here the options are known up front, which is also what lets the GUI render a proper dropdown and lets a command tab-complete the values.
